title: Scientists discover a hidden factor that can make or break chemical reactions
caption:
Chemists discovered that controlling the microscopic acidity right next to an electrode is the secret to perfect chemical production. By optimizing this 'local pH,' they boosted reaction efficiency from 16% to 97%.

Source: Sciencedaily - Scientists discover a hidden factor that can make or break chemical reactions

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261008005244.htm
